english.title: Drive a relevant vehicle on a road prior to completing / after five years of a CPC etc
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a relevant vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..), having neither successfully completed the appropriate initial CPC test or Swiss initial CPC test nor been the holder of a valid CPC, national periodic CPC or Swiss CPC, nor completed a national return to driving course within a period not exceeding one year beginning with the day on which you had completed that national return to driving course had elapsed
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 10(1) and (3) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drove a relevant vehicle on a road
before he / she had successfully completed an appropriate initial certificate of professional competence test as required by the Vehicle Drivers (CPC) Reg's 2007 / Swiss initial CPC test OR
without holding a valid CPC, national periodic CPC or Swiss CPC OR
where a period in excess of one year having elapsed since he / she completed the national return to driving course
relating to motor vehicles of the category into which this particular relevant vehicle fell
